content_sections.text: The selection process consists of shortlisting candidates based on their merit and project requirements, followed by an interview conducted in online mode.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Field Investigator
content_sections.text: Check eligibility criteria for the Field Investigator position from the official notification. Prepare a detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV). Scan certificates regarding educational qualifications, age, and desirable qualifications. Merge the detailed CV and scanned certificates into a single PDF document. Send the application via email to [email protected] before the deadline of 25 October 2026 at 5 PM. Ensure the email indicates the project title and project number in the submission.

Candidates must indicate the project title and project number in their email application. The tenure of the project and position is 03 months. Shortlisted candidates will be informed about the date of the interview. The interview will be conducted in online mode. Mere possession of the minimum qualification does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and project requirements.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad?
faq.answer: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad has invited applications for 3 Field Investigator positions under an ICSSR sponsored research project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Field Investigator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available for the Field Investigator post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Field Investigator?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 25 October 2026 till 5 PM (20 days from the date of the advertisement dated 05.10.2026).

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate in any Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks, with preference given to candidates with a four-year graduation program.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Field Investigator?
faq.answer: Candidates should preferably be below 35 years of age, with relaxation applicable as per GoI norms.
